title: Tri-SDK session pivot: clarify credential surface & reshape pullstream ergonomics
author: Maya Rodriguez
description:
Motivation: multiple SDK customers reported cognitive overhead when handling credential rotation + streaming retries. This PR introduces a small, backward-compatible "session pivot" concept that centralizes credential lookup and exposes a single lightweight adapter surface for streaming consumers. Goal is to reduce cross-SDK mental friction, harmonize retry presets for transient auth errors, and tighten PullStream ergonomics so cross-language examples are closer to parity.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces a SessionPivot facade in the core SDK bindings that normalizes credential lookup and lease refresh semantics.
- Adds language-specific adapters: a thin Python 'SessionProxy', a TypeScript 'sessionPivot' helper, and a Go 'sessionadapter' with identical public intent.
- Reworks PullStream API ergonomics: smaller iterator primitive, clearer cancelation points, and an explicit resume() primitive for resumable consumers.
- Harmonizes retry preset names (auth_transient -> auth_recoverable) and attaches them to session refresh hooks so streaming consumers get coherent automatic reauth.
- Adds migration notes and compatibility adapters so consumers can opt-in incrementally.

Why this is safe: all adapters are additive and the original Polling/Token interfaces remain available. The new helpers are designed for opt-in migration (no forced break). A compatibility shim translates old retry config to the new preset names at runtime for existing clients.

Checklist: 
- [x] SessionPivot facade implemented in core SDK glue.
- [x] Python adapter + unit tests.
- [x] TypeScript helper + integration tests.
- [x] Go adapter + small e2e harness.
- [x] Docs / migration guide updated.
- [x] Version bumps: python -> 1.8.0, typescript -> 2.3.1, go -> 1.5.2.

Notes for reviewers: pay attention to the retry semantics in "session_pivot/README.md" and the types in the TS helper (I preserved structural typing so it should be non-invasive). The Go adapter intentionally avoids reflection for simpler onboarding.

Release notes: Add new SessionPivot helpers for easier credential rotation handling across SDKs; minor ergonomics improvements to PullStream API; non-breaking migration shims.

Related: ENG-1459 (streaming auth ergonomic issues), ENG-1503 (retry preset consolidation).
